# ASUS Belgium extra warranty 2026 — SRC-0216

## Source

https://www.asus.com/be-nl/events/infoM/activity_free_warranty_extension

## What it proves

New eligible G615LW purchases from 1 June through 31 December 2026 can receive one extra year of standard warranty when registered with proof of purchase by 31 January 2027. Final eligibility remains subject to ASUS approval and the standard-warranty exclusions remain in force.
